chunks: From him, from Safwan and Fadalah ibn Ayyub and Ibn Abi Umayr, from Jamil ibn Darrāj, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
It is not proper for the Imam to perform the Zuhr prayer except at Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah; and he should spend the night there, remain until the sun rises, and then depart.

key_terms.الظُّهْرَ: the Zuhr prayer performed at midday
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, referring here to the prayer leader or divinely designated leader in the ritual context
key_terms.بِمِنًى: at Mina, the sacred location associated with hajj rites
key_terms.تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ: the rising of the sun, marking the time after which departure occurs
key_terms.يَوْمَ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the Day of Tarwiyah, the eighth day of Dhu al-Hijjah

ai.seo_question: When should the Imam go out to Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah during hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith states the proper timing and manner of the Imam’s departure to Mina on the Day of Tarwiyah during hajj. It indicates that Zuhr should be performed at Mina, that the night should be spent there, and that departure should take place after sunrise.
